inferred_north_star.definition: The percentage of trial users who convert to a monthly paid plan and complete an exercise within the month.
inferred_north_star.justification: This metric captures the effectiveness of our onboarding process and user engagement strategy, which are critical for driving revenue growth.

supporting_metrics.name: Trial→Monthly Conversion
supporting_metrics.definition: The percentage of trial users who convert to a monthly paid plan.
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric indicates the success of our onboarding process and user acquisition strategy.

supporting_metrics.name: W1 Retention
supporting_metrics.definition: The percentage of monthly converters who complete an exercise within the first week post-conversion.
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric evaluates the effectiveness of our habit formation strategy and user engagement tactics.

lifecycle_stages.primary_goal: Convert users to a monthly paid plan
Drive habit formation and user engagement
Re-engage inactive users with personalized content
Win back inactive users with limited-time offers
